[To [Elizabeth Missing Sewell](/person/1301)]
All right. [M](/person/939) sends them to me for nothing.

You shall have them.

Has he sent you the [Scripture Readings](/book/87)
C M Y


[^1]: A postcard postmarked Winchester D My 13 71 and Ventnor My 14.
